findings: Test seam mismatch: tests use mocked canvas context but never verify actual rendering behavior. The tests confirm internal method calls (save, translate, rotate, stroke) but do not validate that the spacecraft is rendered with correct physics-based position/rotation from AC-12, or that the rotating station and docking port are rendered correctly from AC-13. This is a tautological test pattern that tests test mechanics, not AC behavior. [tests/renderer.test.js]

Missing AC integration verification: No tests verify that Renderer2D.render() actually visualizes the simulation state correctly. Tests should verify that spacecraft position, rotation, velocity, station rotation, and docking port position from simulationState are correctly transformed to screen coordinates and rendered. Current tests only check that clear() is called, not that content is rendered correctly. [tests/renderer.test.js]

Missing end-to-end rendering validation: Tests should verify that the render pipeline produces correct visual output for AC-12 (physics-based spacecraft controls) and AC-13 (rotating station and docking port). For example, tests should verify that given a simulationState with specific spacecraft position/rotation, the renderer draws the spacecraft at the correct screen location with correct orientation. [tests/renderer.test.js]

Coordinate transformation testing incomplete: While _worldToScreen and _screenToWorld are tested, there are no tests verifying that these transformations work correctly in the context of actual rendering. Tests should verify that spacecraft position (0,0) with rotation Math.PI/4 renders at the expected screen location with correct orientation. [tests/renderer.test.js]

Docking port visualization unverified: AC-13 requires rotating station and docking port. The implementation includes docking port rendering but tests never verify that the docking port is rendered at the correct world position relative to the rotating station. Tests should verify docking port position and orientation are correctly calculated and rendered. [tests/renderer.test.js]

Debug visualization untested: The implementation includes velocity vectors and debug info display, but tests never verify these features work correctly. Tests should verify that velocity vectors are drawn in the correct direction and magnitude when debug mode is enabled. [tests/renderer.test.js]
